# Solomon Wakhungu (harlo.dev)

> Houston-based Senior Software Engineer at Credera (formerly Amazon, Aviatrix, and Neurescence), upstream open-source contributor to HashiCorp Terraform, CNCF Helm, and VictoriaMetrics, and creator of 13 developer tools and 5 live applications on harlo.dev.

## Who is Solomon Wakhungu?
Solomon Wakhungu is a Senior Software Engineer specializing in AWS, Kubernetes, Go, Python, Terraform, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) infrastructure. He has 16+ merged upstream pull requests in foundational cloud and observability repositories, built an Amazon Alexa skill serving 407,000+ monthly requests, automated 4-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) infrastructure in Go and Terraform at Aviatrix, and maintains a production ecosystem of open-source developer tools distributed via Homebrew, PyPI, npm, Docker/GHCR, and GitHub Actions. He studied Computer Science at The University of Texas at Dallas and holds the Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional credential.

For the complete dossier, see: https://harlo.dev/llms-full.txt

## Live harlo.dev Applications
- [kFLEET](https://kfleet.harlo.dev): 14 MB single-binary Go control plane for Kubernetes fleets with a 3-rule read-only ClusterRole, embedded Primer React UI, SQLite timeline, and 9 read-only MCP tools (GitHub: https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/kfleet).
- [gronify](https://gronify.harlo.dev): Streaming gron-style CLI on npm and Homebrew flattening 1,000 MiB JSON in 3.63s at 65 MiB RSS (GitHub: https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/gronify).
- [Tonal](https://tonal.harlo.dev): Editorial tonal UI design system and shadcn-compatible component registry built with 12 flat surface CSS tokens (GitHub: https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/tonal).
- [RunPod vLLM Deployer](https://vllm.harlo.dev): Python CLI that plans offline, confirms billable actions, deploys, checks readiness, smoke tests, and tears down OpenAI-compatible vLLM servers on RunPod GPUs (GitHub: https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/runpod-vllm-deployer).
- [Typst Dev Container](https://typst.harlo.dev): Reproducible Typst, Pandoc, and Rust Dev Container published to ghcr.io with automated CI toolchain updates and smoke tests (GitHub: https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/typst-dev-container).

## Additional Open-Source Projects
- [action-hub](https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/action-hub) (Explainer: https://1solomonwakhungu.github.io/action-hub/): Indexed on-demand meta-MCP layer (~600 baseline tokens; load-tested at 44 servers, 10,000 tools, and 5,000 skills).
- [discord-cli](https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/discord-cli): Headless REST-first Python CLI (v1.9.0) with 89 commands across 20 groups, deterministic safety policies, runtime JSON Schemas, PyPI/Homebrew/Docker/GitHub Action distribution, and an installable agent skill.
- [contexto](https://github.com/VentureForgre/contexto): Zero-dependency local proxy keeping Claude Code and Codex under a fixed token bound with verbatim disk paging and MCP recall.
- [googlemcp](https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/googlemcp): Local stdio MCP server for 19 Google APIs, read-only by default with per-product write and destructive opt-ins plus Terraform API enablement.
- [Terraform AWS Private LLM](https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/terraform-aws-private-llm): Reusable Terraform module for EC2-based Ollama and Open WebUI with encrypted EBS gp3, Caddy auto-TLS, and optional Route 53.
- [Homebrew Tap](https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/homebrew-tap): Unified Homebrew tap distributing kfleet, gronify, discordcli-agents, and openrig with automated CI formula updates.
- [Homeserver Infrastructure](https://github.com/1solomonwakhungu/homeserver-infra): Terraform and Terragrunt stacks for cloud-init Proxmox VMs, reusable modules, remote state, and operator runbooks.
